entry.hypothesis: Purchase filings by NON-routine insiders (no same-calendar-month purchase already usable in each of the 3 prior years) carry the information; routine purchases carry none (PREREG H1).
entry.rationale: Cohen, Malloy & Pomorski (2012) - stripping routine traders roughly doubles the predictive content of insider trades.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
